OrderSession.title: OrderSession
OrderSession.description: Represents a shared dorm food and grocery order session managed by the Master (runner).

title.description: Name of the order session or restaurant/store

masterName.description: Name of the roommate acting as the Master (fetching the order)

roomCode.description: Short alphanumeric room code for roommates

deliveryFee.description: Total delivery or service fee to split or track

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the order session

ownerId.description: UID of the creator of the session

memberUids.description: Bounded list of up to 10 roommate UIDs participating in this session

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session was last updated

RoommateOrderItem.title: RoommateOrderItem
RoommateOrderItem.description: An individual food or grocery item requested by a roommate in an order session.

sessionOwnerId.description: UID of the parent session owner

authorUid.description: UID of the authenticated user who submitted this item

memberUids.description: Bounded list of up to 10 roommate UIDs with read access

roommateName.description: Display name of the roommate ordering the item

roomNumber.description: Room or bed label in the dorm

itemName.description: Name of the requested item (e.g., شيبسي, كشري, بيبسي)

normalizedItemKey.description: Normalized Arabic key used to aggregate identical items for the Master

quantity.description: Quantity of the item requested (1 to 100)

unitPrice.description: Price per single unit in EGP

paymentMethod.description: Whether the roommate is paying cash or digital wallet

cashPaidAmount.description: Amount of cash handed to the Master in EGP

isPaid.description: Whether the roommate has settled payment for this item

isPurchased.description: Whether the Master has bought this item

notes.description: Optional customization notes (e.g. بدون شطة, عائلي)

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when item was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when item was updated

/sessions/{sessionId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Stores individual roommate order items belonging to a specific order session.
